question: The total cost price of a watch and a fan is Rs. 1,170. Rama sells the watch at a profit of 20% and the fan at a profit of 25%. If he earns a total profit of Rs. 265, then the cost price of watch is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume the entire amount of Rs. 1170 was spent on the fan at 25% profit.

Expected Profit = 25% of 1170 = Rs. 292.5

Difference in profit = 292.5 − 265 = Rs. 27.5

This extra Rs. 27.5 is due to the 5% difference in profit rates (25% − 20%).

5% of CP of Watch = 27.5 ⇒ CP of Watch = 27.5 × 20 = Rs. 550

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total CP of watch and fan = Rs. 1170
